jurisdiction: South Africa — FIC Act 38 of 2001, Directive 9 (crypto-asset Travel Rule); FATF (2020) Virtual Asset Red Flag Indicators; FATF Recommendations 15 & 16
source_notes: ACTIVE rulebook. Real regulatory corpus prepared by the domain team, replacing the 40-rule placeholder demo set (preserved unmodified in data/rulebook.legacy.json for diffing). Only DS-01..DS-05 are populated so far; DS-06 onward will be added once the schema (rule_type indicator/obligation, trigger_schema grammar) holds on these five. ALL rule text in the `text` field is a PROVISIONAL PARAPHRASE by the domain team, NOT verified exact regulatory wording - do not present it as authoritative without checking the cited source_ref. Demonstration/development data only.

rules.name: Rapid deposit followed by rapid trade or withdrawal
rules.text: PROVISIONAL PARAPHRASE, not exact regulatory text - to be confirmed by the domain team. A large initial deposit is made to open a new account, inconsistent with the customer's declared profile, and the customer trades or withdraws most or all of the balance within a day or two of account opening.
rules.trigger: New account AND deposit value inconsistent with stated profile AND rapid trade/withdrawal (same day or next day).
mitre_atlas: AML.CS0033 (technique ID unverified) - deepfake/liveness-bypass identity onboarding

rules.name: Structuring or high-value clustering in transaction pattern
rules.text: PROVISIONAL PARAPHRASE, not exact regulatory text - to be confirmed by the domain team. Transfers are structured into amounts just under a reporting threshold, or multiple high-value transfers are made in quick succession within a short window (e.g. 24 hours).
rules.trigger: Repeated sub-threshold transfers OR high-value transfers clustered in a short (e.g. 24-hour) window.

rules.name: Travel Rule — transmission of originator and beneficiary information
rules.text: PROVISIONAL PARAPHRASE, not exact regulatory text - to be confirmed by the domain team. An ordering CASP must transmit the originator's and beneficiary's required identifying information to the recipient CASP at or before the transfer, and must not execute the transfer if it cannot meet this requirement.
rules.trigger: OBLIGATION, encoded as its breach: fires when a qualifying transfer occurs AND the required originator/beneficiary information was not transmitted.

rules.name: Transactions with counterparties with weak or absent KYC controls
rules.text: PROVISIONAL PARAPHRASE, not exact regulatory text - to be confirmed by the domain team. Funds are sent to, or received from, a VASP with demonstrably weak or absent CDD controls, or the transfer involves an unhosted wallet. NOTE: this rule also carries an obligation aspect (Directive 9 para 8.2 imposes risk-based controls on unhosted-wallet transfers) that is encoded here only as the indicator half - see the mismatch note for this rule.
rules.trigger: Counterparty VASP has demonstrably weak/no CDD, OR transfer involves an unhosted wallet.
rules.source: FATF (2020) Virtual Assets Red Flags; FIC (2024) Directive 9

rules.name: Fan-in / fan-out accumulation to a single account
rules.text: PROVISIONAL PARAPHRASE, not exact regulatory text - to be confirmed by the domain team. Repeated transfers are made to one account from multiple senders or IP addresses within a time window, or funds accumulate from many wallets before being consolidated and moved on.
rules.trigger: Repeated transfers to one account from multiple senders/IPs within a time window, OR fan-in accumulation followed by consolidation.
